role: Synthetic method qualification on checksum-verified real CHELSA geometry only. Observed flower-colour values remain closed and no frozen empirical decision may change.

inputs.photo_frame: retained classifiable rows jointly complete across all twelve CHELSA variables; no missing-value replacement or block-specific photo substitution

representation.candidate_axis_grid: 32 fixed unit vectors in R4 generated once from seed 202609070701 and reused for every block/stage/replicate
representation.generator_axes: continuous unit-sphere draws in R4 independent of the candidate-axis grid
representation.axis_sign: marginalized by an equal plus/minus species-sign prior

models.candidate_intercept_prior: equal over the fixed five-point threshold grid independently for each species
models.score: held-out predictive log-density gain per target photo, averaged equally over target species and four regional folds

synthetic_generator.shared_axis_rule: round(369 * shared_fraction) species use one common continuous R4 axis within the tested climate block; remaining species use independent continuous R4 axes

replication.deterministic_sharding: 3 blocks x 2 stages x 10 nonoverlapping 25-replicate shards

calibration.primary_decision_threshold: for each model, maximum empirical 97.5th percentile (method=higher) across all 36 block-by-nuisance calibration distributions

required_outputs: all calibration and evaluation scores with four fold contributions
all block-by-arm decision counts and Wilson 95% intervals
paired intercept-marginal minus fixed-zero detection changes
independent arm census and threshold recomputation
source/code/output checksums and immutable empirical-claim guards
stop_rules: If the checksum-verified real-climate artifact or geometry lineage differs, stop.
If joint-complete 12-variable support no longer retains the frozen fold capacities, stop without relaxing the frame.
If any richer nuisance arm rejects excessively, retain it and fail the corresponding qualification gate; do not drop the arm.
Do not inspect observed flower colours during this stage.
Do not open empirical real-climate flower-colour inference automatically after a favourable result; a separate empirical contract is still required.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic recoverability and finite-family calibration of the prespecified response-sharing statistic on the actual SHA-locked CHELSA geometry. Not evidence that real flower colours respond to heat, water balance, dryness, radiation or any climate block; not adaptation, causality, prevalence, or a universally calibrated <=5% test.
